title: Hollywood Studios Showtime
intro: [excited] Lights! Camera! Buzzers! Tonight's whole board is Disney's Hollywood Studios: stunt shows, drop towers, launch coasters and dinner in a drive-in. [laughs] Places, everyone, we're rolling!

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A glamorous old-Hollywood boulevard at dusk with neon marquees, a looming abandoned hotel tower struck by lightning, searchlights sweeping the sky and a vintage film camera on a tripod.

categories.title: Why'd It Have to Be Snakes?
categories.intro: Our film category has been doing stunts at the Studios since day one. [dramatic] It's Raiders of the Lost Ark! Grab your fedora.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A worn brown fedora and coiled leather bullwhip resting on an ancient stone altar, a golden idol glinting in torchlight, a giant stone boulder looming in a dusty temple corridor.

clues.clue: Indiana Jones never leaves home without this long leather weapon, which he cracks to swing across pits.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a bullwhip! [laughs] And the fedora. Never forget the hat. He literally reaches back for it.

clues.clue: Indy is brave about almost everything except these slithering creatures.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is snakes! [whispers] And of course, the Well of Souls is absolutely full of them. Rough day at the office.

clues.clue: In the film's famous opening, Indy runs for his life from a giant rolling one of these.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a boulder! [excited] The Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular recreates it live at the Studios. Run, Indy, run!

clues.clue: Indy races the Nazis to find this sacred chest, said to hold the stone tablets of the Ten Commandments.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Ark of the Covenant! [gasps] Pro tip: if you ever find it, do NOT open it. Keep your eyes closed.

clues.clue: Indy finds his old flame Marion Ravenwood running a tough mountain bar in this country.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Nepal! [laughs] Her bar is the Raven, and she can out-drink anyone in the room. Indy is not ready.

categories.title: Ride the Studios
categories.intro: Next, Ride the Studios! These are the big rides on the Studios' back lot. [chuckles] Keep your arms inside the limo.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A glowing pink electric guitar-shaped roller coaster track twisting through a neon city night, giant toy carnival targets, and the silhouette of a starship hangar in the distance.

clues.clue: In this Toy Story Land ride, you wear 3D glasses and fire at carnival-style games with Woody and friends.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Toy Story Mania! [excited] Pro tip: aim for the hidden targets. And yes, it's fine to be competitive with your grandma.

clues.clue: This dark coaster on Sunset Boulevard launches riders from 0 to 57 miles per hour in about 2.8 seconds.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Rock 'n' Roller Coaster! [gasps] Zero to highway speed before you can finish screaming 'wait'.

clues.clue: From 1999 until 2026, riders on Rock 'n' Roller Coaster raced through L.A. to catch a concert by this band.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Aerosmith! [laughs] In 2026 the Muppets took over the limo. Dr. Teeth and the Electric Mayhem, take it away!

clues.clue: In this Galaxy's Edge ride, you get captured by the First Order and must escape their Star Destroyer.
clues.answer: Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance
accept: star wars: rise of the resistance
star wars rise of the resistance
choices: Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Rise of the Resistance! [whispers] It's long, it's epic, and you will absolutely hide from a stormtrooper at some point.

clues.clue: This 3D Muppet show played at the Studios from 1991 to 2025, and it was the final major project of Jim Henson.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Muppet Vision 3D! [sighs] It opened a year to the day after Jim Henson died. Disney recorded it for preservation before it closed.

categories.title: Studio Snapshots
categories.intro: Time for Studio Snapshots! These are real photos from Hollywood Studios. [excited] Name what you're looking at.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A pile of glossy vintage photographs scattered on a director's chair, showing glimpses of a tower, a water tower and a movie palace, a clapperboard without writing beside them.

clues.clue: Name this Toy Story Land coaster.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Slinky Dog Dash! [laughs] Slinky stretches his springy body around the whole track, and the land makes you feel toy-sized in Andy's backyard.

source.author: elisfkc from Orlando, FL, United States

clues.clue: Name the scary ride inside this crumbling hotel.
clues.answer: The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror
accept: the twilight zone tower of terror
choices: The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Tower of Terror! [gasps] The building is 199 feet tall, kept just under 200 so it wouldn't need an airplane warning light.

clues.clue: Today, this copy of a famous Hollywood movie palace houses which attraction?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mickey and Minnie's Runaway Railway! [excited] It opened in 2020 inside the Chinese Theater, where the Great Movie Ride used to live.

clues.clue: This giant icon stood in front of the Chinese Theater from 2001 to 2015. What was it?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Sorcerer's Hat! [sighs] It was over 120 feet tall and basically a giant pin-trading store. Gone, but not forgotten.

clues.clue: This water tower with a famous pair of ears stood over the Studios until 2016. What was it called?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Earffel Tower! [laughs] A 130-foot water tower wearing Mickey ears. Peak theme park fashion.

categories.title: Backlot Backstory
categories.intro: Our parks category is Backlot Backstory! [mischievously] How well do you know the Studios' own life story?

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. An old studio backlot at sunset with a tram winding past soundstages, a vintage city street facade, a fake canyon with a tanker truck and film reels stacked by a gate.

clues.clue: Guests enter Hollywood Studios onto this street, named for a famous road in Los Angeles.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Hollywood Boulevard! [excited] Sunset Boulevard branches off it toward the Tower of Terror. Very L.A., minus the traffic.

clues.clue: Hollywood Studios first opened under this name, with a partner film studio in the title.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Disney-MGM Studios! [chuckles] MGM's roaring lion and Mickey shared billing for almost twenty years.

clues.clue: Disney-MGM Studios opened on May 1 of this year.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 1989! [laughs] It's the third Walt Disney World park, opened while there were real film and animation studios working inside.

clues.clue: The park officially changed its name to Disney's Hollywood Studios in this year.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 2008! [whispers] Fans still call it MGM sometimes. Old habits die hard.

clues.clue: The Studio Backlot Tour's tram ride ended in this fiery flash-flood canyon until the tour closed in 2014.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Catastrophe Canyon! [gasps] Fire, explosions and a tidal wave of water, all on one tram. They did not skimp on drama.

categories.title: Dinner and a Show
categories.intro: Our fan category is Dinner and a Show! [excited] The Studios might have the most theatrical restaurants in all of Disney.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A retro drive-in movie theater at night with diners seated in classic convertible cars, a giant green dinosaur-shaped ice cream stand by a lake, and a slice of grapefruit cake on a fancy plate.

clues.clue: Gertie, the giant green dinosaur by Echo Lake, is actually a stand that sells this sweet frozen treat.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is ice cream! [laughs] Dinosaur Gertie's Ice Cream of Extinction. Best shop name in Florida, don't argue with me.

clues.clue: At this Studios restaurant, you eat dinner sitting in a classic car while old sci-fi movies play on a giant screen.
accept: sci fi dine in theater restaurant
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater Restaurant! [chuckles] Popcorn, burgers and alien invasions. Date night solved.

clues.clue: At this Studios restaurant, servers act like your family members and nag you to keep your elbows off the table.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the 50's Prime Time Café! [laughs] Clean your plate, or no dessert. Mom's rules apply.

clues.clue: The Hollywood Brown Derby is famous for the Cobb salad and for this citrus-filled dessert cake.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is grapefruit cake! [excited] It's a recipe from the original Brown Derby in Los Angeles. Tart, sweet, very old-Hollywood.

clues.clue: Until it closed in 2025 to make room for a Monsters, Inc. area, this Grand Avenue restaurant served Italian dishes like flatbreads and pasta.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mama Melrose's! [sighs] Mama served her last flatbread in May 2025. Tony's and Via Napoli are still around if you need a pasta fix.
